entries.title: CFTC seeks comment on renewal of its customer clearing documentation collection; comments due November 23, 2026
entries.facts: A CFTC notice published in the Federal Register on October 22, 2026 (document 2026-21581) announces a submission to the Office of Management and Budget for review of an extension of the currently approved information collection under OMB Control No. 3038-0092, "Customer Clearing Documentation and Timing of Acceptance for Clearing." The collection covers 17 CFR part 1 for futures commission merchants (sections 1.72 through 1.74), part 23 for swap dealers and major swap participants (sections 23.606 through 23.610), and part 39 for derivatives clearing organizations (sections 39.12 and 39.20). The notice states that comments must be submitted on or before November 23, 2026.
entries.relevant_to: futures commission merchants, swap dealers, derivatives clearing organizations

entries.title: CFTC seeks comment on its collection for the review of swaps for mandatory clearing; comments due November 23, 2026
entries.facts: A CFTC notice published in the Federal Register on October 22, 2026 (document 2026-21579) announces a submission to the Office of Management and Budget for review of the information collection under OMB Control No. 3038-0097, "Process for Review of Swaps for Mandatory Clearing." The notice ties the collection to Commission Regulation 39.5, which it states sets forth the process for those submissions. The notice states that comments must be submitted on or before November 23, 2026.
entries.relevant_to: derivatives clearing organizations, swap dealers, futures commission merchants
